evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to complex tasks by conditioning on thousands of demonstration examples, but this paradigm shifts the inference efficiency bottleneck to the key-value (KV) cache memory.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experimental results on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that our method achieves up to 50% reduction in KV cache memory and 1.8x throughput improvement, with negligible performance degradation on classification and reasoning benchmarks, significantly outperforming prior baselines.
